stem: Two seed lots are germinated under the same controlled conditions. Lot A reaches 95% emergence and Lot B reaches 45%. Which hypothesis becomes stronger?
choices: Lot-specific viability or storage history may be contributing
The room temperature must have been different for only Lot B
All germination problems are caused by fertilizer
rationale: When conditions are held constant and one lot performs much worse, lot viability or storage history becomes a stronger explanation.
